headings: PUMPKIN SPICE SCENTED CANDLE PACK (SET OF 3)

jsonld_raw.name: PUMPKIN SPICE SCENTED CANDLE PACK (SET OF 3)
jsonld_raw.description:
Conical scented candles in different colors, decorated with reliefs inspired by pumpkins, mushrooms, leaves, and acorns.

Pumpkin Spice | An invitation to your deepest memories. Warm, surprising spices that reveal a delicious sweet pumpkin accord intertwined with creamy notes of sandalwood and cashmere.

Fragrance notes:
Top: Citrus, Nutmeg
Heart: Pumpkin
Base: Cinnamon, Spices, Cashmeran, Dry wood

The pack includes 3 units in different shapes and colors.
